ground_truth.title: Data Science Courses
ground_truth.main_content:
Future Proof with AI

Master how to use AI in your everyday work and drive impact at your organization. Access on-demand learning modules, expert-led sessions, and Harvard insights that help you apply AI to real business challenges—join today for access through September 2026.

Data Science: Probability

Learn probability theory — essential for a data scientist — using a case study on the financial crisis of 2007–2008.

Fundamentals of TinyML

Focusing on the basics of machine learning and embedded systems, such as smartphones, this course will introduce you to the "language" of TinyML.

Business Analytics

Develop a data mindset and the analytical skills to interpret and communicate data while applying concepts to real business problems in this course from Harvard Business School (HBS) Online.

AI Essentials for Business

Build a foundational understanding of AI concepts with this course from Harvard Business School (HBS) Online.

Advanced Bioconductor

Learn advanced approaches to genomic visualization, reproducible analysis, data architecture, and exploration of cloud-scale consortium-generated genomic data.

CORe

This three-course program from Harvard Business School (HBS) Online will teach you the fundamental skills to confidently contribute to business decisions and decision-making.

Safety, Quality, Informatics and Leadership

This Harvard Medical School one-year, application-based certificate program helps leaders effect positive change by learning to turn patient data into actionable, transformable knowledge.

ground_truth.main_content_markdown:
### [Future Proof with AI](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/future-proof-ai)

Master how to use AI in your everyday work and drive impact at your organization. Access on-demand learning modules, expert-led sessions, and Harvard insights that help you apply AI to real business challenges—join today for access through September 2026.

### [Data Science: Probability](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/data-science-probability)

Learn probability theory — essential for a data scientist — using a case study on the financial crisis of 2007–2008.

### [Fundamentals of TinyML](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/fundamentals-tinyml)

Focusing on the basics of machine learning and embedded systems, such as smartphones, this course will introduce you to the "language" of TinyML.

### [Business Analytics](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/business-analytics)

Develop a data mindset and the analytical skills to interpret and communicate data while applying concepts to real business problems in this course from Harvard Business School (HBS) Online.

### [AI Essentials for Business](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/ai-essentials-business)

Build a foundational understanding of AI concepts with this course from Harvard Business School (HBS) Online.

### [Advanced Bioconductor](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/data-analysis-life-sciences-6-high-performance-computing-reproducible-genomics)

Learn advanced approaches to genomic visualization, reproducible analysis, data architecture, and exploration of cloud-scale consortium-generated genomic data.

### [CORe](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/core)

This three-course program from Harvard Business School (HBS) Online will teach you the fundamental skills to confidently contribute to business decisions and decision-making.

### [Safety, Quality, Informatics and Leadership](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/safety-quality-informatics-and-leadership)

This Harvard Medical School one-year, application-based certificate program helps leaders effect positive change by learning to turn patient data into actionable, transformable knowledge.
